title: Classify four transformations
promptMarkdown: Let $P=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,-1,-1)$,$T=\operatorname{diag}(-1,1,1,1)$, and $B$ be an $x$ boost of rapidity $r\in\mathbb R$. Verify that $P,T,B,PT$ preserve $\eta$. Compute determinant and time-orientation signs for each and determine which can be continuously connected to identity within $O(1,3)$. Prove the inverse formula and explain why a translation is not represented by an ordinary 4 by 4 Lorentz matrix acting linearly on all event positions.
hintLadder: Check the time column as well as the determinant.
Test a translation at the origin.
